_doc: Generated by game/tools/sprite_pipeline.gd (FLEET_PACK.md T-016). Schema: id, name, tbd, world_height (DESIGN.md section 5 body-size table, SR-2; null where the section gives the enemy no row), animations[] {name, fps, loop, frames[] (paths relative to this folder), body_rect[] (tight bbox of alpha > 16 per frame, the HITBOXES shape), world_height per animation/frame where it differs}, sources[] = the ENEMIES.md 'Attachment mapping' state. Resourced at res://content/enemies/<id>/sprites.json.

anim._doc: T-083 (research/fable-tickets.md section 1.9 - the table is the spec; ENEMIES.md frozen, D-040). One entry per state of the section 1.9 table. Frames are file names relative to this folder (the T-016 names): idle_00.png (the base seal, the spec's seal_00) and dash_00.png/dash_01.png (the dash stand-ins, the spec's seal_01 mouth-open + seal_02/03 flap overlays - NONE of those exist in the TBD sheet; every state uses the TBD frames, timings exactly as the table says). Driven by the SIM state and its tick counter, never a wall-clock timer.

spawn.timing_note: common fade (section 1.0): alpha 0 -> 1 over 30 ticks, scale 0.8 -> 1.0; the body cannot touch or kill until the fade completes

idle_flap.timing_note: table: 'seal_02 <-> seal_03 loop, 9 ticks per frame'. TBD stand-in: the sheet holds the single placeholder frame idle_00; the 9-tick-per-frame flap cadence is kept - the frame-count mismatch is inherent to the TBD art (TBD.md)

params.line: the fixed 3D dash line: seal body centre through the player centre (0.9 u above the player's feet), extended to 20 u; fixed at telegraph start, never re-aims

telegraph.timing_note: 45 ticks (0.75 s), binding. Table: 'seal_01 (mouth open), held'; TBD stand-in holds idle_00 (no mouth-open frame exists - TBD.md). The dashed red line is drawn along the 3D dash line, brightening over the 45 ticks; the seal starts a telegraph only between 4 u and 12 u from its target

params.flap_overlay: dash_00 <-> dash_01 stands in for the seal_02/03 flap overlay at 4 ticks per frame; the spec's seal_01 mouth-open frame does not exist in the TBD sheet (TBD.md)

attack.timing_note: 60 ticks (1.0 s), binding: 20 u along the fixed 3D line; the bark plays on tick 0 of the dash; flap at 4 ticks per frame. TBD stand-in frames alternate dash_00/dash_01

recover.timing_note: 45 ticks (0.75 s), binding; table: 'seal_00' (TBD idle_00 stands in)

name: seal
